text:
olivia: Heads-up: AuroraCompute asked for a joint performance sweep focused on efficiency (Watt/token) and sustained throughput across thermal profiles. They want a short marketplace card + co-branded blog. Can we scope?
harry: we can. propose models: small-medium suite: distilgpt2, mpt-7b-instruct-lite, and a trimmed Llama-2-7b. sequences: 128, 1024, 1536. batch sizes 1,2,4, concurrency 1..8.
mei: add toggles for two runtime configs: (A) stock kernel + int8 quant, (B) aurora-kernel with fused-attn + dynamic frequency scaling. Need to report both lines.
jordan: partner asked to include thermal run (30m sustained) to show throttling inflection point — capture board inlet/outlet temp and fan RPM. They will share INA power rails and a rack-level PDUs CSV.
olivia: product asks for a single-graphic perf card (throughput vs watt) and a 2-line summary for the marketplace tile. embargo until joint sign-off. timeline?
harry: dry-run Monday, full sweep Wed-Thu. blockers: partner signs bench addendum for kernel changes, legal approves embargo copy, infra grants partner read-only access to aggregated artifacts only.
ops-bot: created job/aurora-efficiency-sweep-2025-06. Config: `models:[distilgpt2,mpt7b-lite,llama2-7b-trim] seq:[128,1024,1536] bs:[1,2,4] conc:[1,2,4,8] kernel_variants:[stock,int8,aurora-fused] sample_ms:100 power_artifact:/artifacts/aurora/$JOB_ID/power.csv thermal:/artifacts/aurora/$JOB_ID/temps.csv`.
mei: can bench include `--dyn-freq=true/false` and `--int8=true/false` toggles so we can run A/B combos? need per-token p95/p99 latency and power percentiles.
ops-bot: yes, template supports `dyn_freq` and `int8` flags and will emit metadata.json with flags for each run. Note: partner requested raw PDU CSVs remain private; only aggregated charts (PNG + summary CSV) will be published.
jordan: reproducibility: include prompt set SHA256 and tokenization command. we'll attach a short appendix with run commands and seed list.
legal: flagged RED-1024 for addendum review. legal needs partner signature before public materials. Also confirm embargo wording before marketing assets are posted.
olivia: thanks. I'll draft the marketplace blurb and embargo language and request Aurora assets (logo + quote) by Tue EOD.
harry: infra will provision pre-signed S3 for aggregated artifacts and a private bucket for full telemetry access for partner/legal only. I can provision Tue AM.
mei: final ask  include thermal curve plot (throughput and avg watt vs time) and a short note about quantization parity. That'll help SI integrators.
olivia: great. tagging ticket RED-1024. syncing Mon 09:30 to confirm legal + assets. ops-bot: job/aurora-efficiency-sweep-2025-06 scheduled for 2025-06-11 08:00 UTC. Logs stream to /artifacts/aurora-efficiency-sweep-2025-06/logs.
